2. The petitioner happens to be the husband of the Opposite Party No.2, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Daudnagar P.S. Case No.223 of 2024, for the offence registered under Sections 341, 323, 506, 498A/34 of the IPC.
3. The allegation against the petitioner is of demand of dowry resulting into institution of the FIR.

4. Learned Advocate for the petitioner contended that in fact on account of family feud, the present FIR has been lodged, though the petitioner has always been ready to keep the informant with all comfort and dignity.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.82287 of 2024(2) dt.11-12-2024 5.

Let notice be issued to O.P. No.2 under both process i.e. ordinary process as well as registered cover with A/D, the requisite of which must be filed preferably within a period of two weeks from today.
